name: zdeclient_map_tree_erase_range
description: zDEClient_MapTreeState erase helpers remove full and partial feature-map ranges while preserving header extents and iteration order.
known_limits: The source restores the VC5 std::_Tree erase behavior and provider-owned std::_Lockit guard trigger; full tier S remains deferred to a coherent zDEClient map-tree byte pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457e80 validates the full-range path through DestroySubtree, header reset, out iterator write, and the partial-range loop through IterNextNodeRef and EraseAndAdvance.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457fe0 validates next iterator capture, node relink/rebalance behavior, node delete, node-count decrement, and returned next iterator.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x458510 validates right-subtree recursion, left-chain iteration, and delete-until-nil behavior for full subtree cleanup.

The native erase-range smoke verifies insertion of ordered feature-map keys, partial erase preserving iteration order and header extents, direct EraseAndAdvance next-node return, full erase through DestroySubtree, node count reset, and header reset.
